blocks.text: Except for beer, it shall be unlawful for any person to possess or consume any other alcoholic liquor in a licensed premises selling cereal malt beverages, unless the premises is also currently licensed by the State Director of Alcoholic Beverage Control. (Ord. 20175 § 20, 3-12-19.)
State Law References: Similar provisions, K.S.A. 41-2704 .
